claims.claim_text: Jerome H Chudej has a high-confidence identifier-backed Army record match.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier, surname and middle initial match an Army entry dated 20 April 1942; the Army name field reads Jero rather than the index's Jerome.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier, surname and middle initial with a one-letter given-name difference; assessed high confidence rather than confirmed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes a wartime observation but not the date or route of later OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is masked publicly. Jero H Chudej is retained as a documented Army-source spelling, not a correction to the index.

claims.claim_text: The Army entry records the occupational category ‘Farm hands, general farms.’
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-backed Army record carries occupation value 316, which the inspected NARA code page labels Farm hands, general farms.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact private identifier, surname and middle initial with a one-letter given-name difference; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Observed with an Army entry date of 20 April 1942; temporal relationship to OSS entry remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: No named farm, employer, location, work dates or self-employment is inferred from the occupational category.

claims.claim_text: Constantine W Chuleas has a high-confidence identifier-backed Army record match corroborated by a published obituary.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier and indexed name match an Army entry dated 20 November 1942. A Flint Journal obituary independently gives the exact name Constantine W. Chuleas and documents World War II Army and OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact full name and exact private identifier in an official Army record, independently corroborated by an exact-name obituary that names Army and OSS service; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry date establishes a wartime observation; the obituary confirms service but not the date of OSS entry or the immediately preceding affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is masked publicly. The obituary's long postwar entertainment work is outside the pre-OSS claim and is not projected backward.

claims.claim_text: The Army entry records the occupational category ‘Stamping occupations in mechanical treatment of metals.’
claims.evidence_excerpt: Stamping occupations in mechanical treatment of metals
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The identifier-backed Army record carries occupation value 688, which the inspected NARA code page labels Stamping occupations in mechanical treatment of metals.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Exact indexed name plus exact private identifier, independently supported by an exact-name Army/OSS obituary; assessed high confidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Observed with an Army entry date of 20 November 1942; temporal relationship to OSS entry remains uncertain.
claims.match_notes: No named employer, factory, metal product, work location or employment period is inferred. Flint residence and later memberships do not justify assigning an automobile company.

claims.claim_text: An exact-name OSS Greek Operational Group candidate remains in the private research review system.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A specialist OSS Operational Groups roster lists 1st Lt. George Chumas with Greek Group VI, but it supplies no identifier that connects the entry to Box 124.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Distinctive exact-name and OSS-context lead, but no private identifier, birth datum, hometown or personnel-file bridge; insufficient for publication as the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The roster concerns OSS service itself and establishes no pre-OSS employer or immediate predecessor assignment.
claims.match_notes: The roster describes itself as under construction. A commercial militaria listing and a forum post were discovery leads only; a 1931-born obituary is chronologically impossible and was rejected.

claims.claim_text: Chin H Chung has an unresolved service-identifier/name conflict.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier returns an Army entry naming Edward F Foster rather than Chin H Chung.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The identifier agrees, but the entire first, middle and last name conflicts. The Army occupation cannot be assigned to the indexed person without direct correction evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflicting Army entry is dated 22 October 1942; no occupation or recruitment chronology is accepted from it.
claims.match_notes: The printed index row remains unchanged and the full identifier remains private. Box 124 and the original Army card require review.
